title: Professional Certificate Course in The Development and Complexity of the Organisation Theory
description: The aim of this course is to educate participants on the major theories and concepts in organizational theory, from classical to contemporary with the advancement of organizational science.
longDescription: Understand the organisation, forms, and dimensions of an organisation. Understand operative goals and needs, and the evolution of organisation theory. Understand organisation theory, and critiques on organisation theory. Optimistic views for organisation theory. The growing barriers, and discoveries of organisation theory. Criticality and importance of a theory to be understood. Complexity in the advancement of organisational science. Development of scientific paradigms. This course is designed to provide a comprehensive understanding of organizational theory, including its evolution, current theories and critiques, and future prospects. The course will begin by examining the basic forms and dimensions of an organization, including its structure, culture, and goals. Students will learn about the operative goals and needs of an organization, and how these have evolved over time.
